s1.syndrome_frame: A slowly growing eyelid mass with recent changes and crust formation
salient_findings: Yellowish-brown, well-circumscribed papule on the central lower eyelid
Flakier surface at one lateral end of the tumor
Hyperkeratotic lesion with pseudohorn cysts and neoplastic squamous cell proliferation
key_facts: 4-year history of a left lower eyelid mass
Recent growth and crust formation noted by the patient's wife
Tumor located on the central lower eyelid without margin involvement
Specimen measured 0.8 × 0.5 × 0.3 cm
Microscopic findings include hyperkeratotic lesion and pseudohorn cysts
Proliferation of neoplastic squamous cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli
Mitotic figures present
Central areas of clear cell change were periodic acid–Schiff positive and diastase sensitive
Negative results with Alcian blue and mucicarmine stains
Negative immunohistochemical stains for adipophilin and androgen receptor

shortlist.label: Squamous cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Proliferation of neoplastic squamous cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli, mitotic figures present

shortlist.label: Basal cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Hyperkeratotic lesion with pseudohorn cysts, central areas of clear cell change

shortlist.label: Sebaceous gland carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Yellowish-brown, well-circumscribed papule on the eyelid, recent growth and crust formation

shortlist.label: Keratoacanthoma
shortlist.why_kept: Rapidly growing, crusted lesion on the eyelid, histopathological findings of hyperkeratotic lesion and pseudohorn cysts

shortlist.label: Actinic keratosis
shortlist.why_kept: Hyperkeratotic lesion with pseudohorn cysts, history of a slowly growing eyelid mass

raw.rationale: The presence of neoplastic squamous cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli, along with mitotic figures, supports the diagnosis of squamous cell carcinoma. The hyperkeratotic lesion and pseudohorn cysts also align with this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Basal cell carcinoma
rejected.why: The microscopic findings do not describe the typical features of basal cell carcinoma, such as palisading nuclei or clefting around tumor nests.

rejected.label: Sebaceous gland carcinoma
rejected.why: The negative immunohistochemical stains for adipophilin and the absence of sebaceous gland differentiation in the microscopic findings argue against this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Keratoacanthoma
rejected.why: While keratoacanthoma can present with a hyperkeratotic lesion and pseudohorn cysts, the presence of mitotic figures and the proliferation of neoplastic squamous cells suggest a more aggressive lesion, such as squamous cell carcinoma.

rejected.label: Actinic keratosis
rejected.why: Actinic keratosis is a precursor lesion that does not typically exhibit the same level of cytological atypia or invasive growth seen in this case.
